3062.title: Restored split layouts allow duplicate thread content
3062.rootCauseOneLine: The persisted split-layout boundary validates unique pane IDs but permits duplicate pane content, and the renderer mounts a complete thread view for every accepted pane node.
3062.proposedFix: Reject persisted split layouts that contain duplicate logical pane content so restoration falls back to the single route-owned pane.
3062.caveats: The visible symptom and persistence gap reproduce on current main. The investigation did not identify a current normal interaction that creates duplicate pane content, so the original writer of the bad persisted layout remains unverified.
